Colonel William Light Memorial
A cast bronze standing statue of Colonel William Light by W. Birnie Rhind (Edinburgh), circa 1906
290 cm in height
On pink granite plinth with sandstone capital and collar
Together with four bronze tablets:
One oblong and with intaglio lettering inscribed 
"Light", 11.5 x 34 cm
Three oblong with raised lettering, 36 x 51.5 cm, 20.5 x 132 cm and 22.5 x 44.5 cm
Together with a circular bronze plaque
with raised lettering surrounded by a 
cast bronze bas-relief laurel wreath, 
57 cm in diameter

The Sir Ross Smith Memorial
Comprising of nine cast bronze elements by Frederick Brook Hitch, cast by A.B. Burton, Founder, London, set on pink granite plinth 
Including:
-  A standing statue of Sir Ross Smith in the ordinary flying uniform of the Military aviator standing on a hemisphere representing the world, with one foot planted on Australia, the other on England, signed F. Brook Hitch A.R.B.S.  And dated 1926 all on the hemisphere, 275 cm in height, base 91.5 cm in width x 92 cm in depth
-  A standing statue of  an angel representing Intrepidity holding and aeroplane, 188.5 cm in height, base 51.5 cm in width x 42 cm
-  A standing statue designed to represent Flight holding a spray of palm leaves and an atlas, 195 cm in height, base 52 cm in width x 42 cm in depth
-  A four panel bas-relief frieze depicting incidents that occurred during the flight, each 50 x 127 cm
-  Four circular laurel wreathes, each 25 cm inn diameter
-  A bas-relief plaque depicting the crew of the Vickers Vimy (Sir Keith Smith, Lieut., W.H. Shiers and Lieut. J.M. Bennett), 105 x 15 cm
-  A bas-relief plaque of an eagle with wings outstretched perched within a crown capped laurel wreath and supporting a line of Sir Keith Smiths's medals and decorations, 55 cm x 115.5 cm

Fireman Gardner's Memorial, 1887
A white marble canopy over four grey marble columns, each with white variegated marble base, standing on granite base
With a cast iron fountain head with later chromium plated drinking spout fitted
